fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAU CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ 060002)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: CATEGORY OF INSTITUTION
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, and Other 3rd Party Data Sources such as Unregulated Saccos, Insurance Companies, etc

fields.name: SUBMITTING INSTITUTION CODE
fields.description: Institution Code of the submitting instutition. E.g. Bank code issued by KBA (e.g. KCB = 01) for Commercial Banks.

fields.name: ACCOUNT HOLDER CATEGORY TYPE
fields.description: Category of account holder e.g Non- financial Corporations, Financial Corporations, General Government, Households and Non- Profit Institutions serving household.

fields.name: ADVERSE LISTING FLAG
fields.description: Whether a record has an adverse listing or not (Y/N)

fields.name: ACCOUNT PRODUCT TYPE
fields.description: Category of product e.g Overdraft, Credit Card, Mortgage, Asset Finance, Business Expansion, Business Working Capital, Trade Finance, Mobile Loan etc.

fields.name: LOAN FACILITY STATUS
fields.description: Status of account, whether closed, dormant, active, written-off, under litigation, under collection, early settlement, with extended terms, fully settled, revoked or suspended.

fields.name: NO OF UNIQUE ACCOUNTS
fields.description: Number of account records held based on uniquely identifiable borrowers

fields.name: REPORT VIEW FLAG
fields.description: The flag establishes the view for the records, either by 'Product Type', 'Sector', 'Amount Bands' or 'Aging Bands'

fields.name: SECTOR CODE
fields.description: International Standard Classification of Economic Activies (ISIC) code for section. E.g 'A' to denote 'Agriculture, forestry and fishing'.

fields.name: AGING
fields.description: Aging band {0 >= 90, >90 and <=180, >180 and <=360 and Over 360 days.

fields.name: VALUE OF RECORDS
fields.description: Account balance aggregated based on the number of uniquely identifiable customers and the associated band.
